items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: picture behind the great Jimmy Rushing (RUSHING).

ctx.x: Well, this is funny. This is at a party with John Levy and his wife, Gail Fisher at that time. And my wife and everybody, we were all just having a good time, so I sat down and started playing some tongue in cheek piano, stride, not realizing that it was going to become that important, and Gordon possibly had put these things in the back of his mind, and before I knew it I was playing stride piano in the
picture behind the great Jimmy Rushing (RUSHING). And we had -- you know, how they used to wear those straw hats, sailor straw hats, striped shirts with the band around the elbows.
